indicators.reason: Callers from this number impersonate Merlion Bank fraud-department officers and ask customers to move money to a 'safe account'.
indicators.advice: Hang up now. Merlion Bank never asks you to transfer money to keep it safe.

indicators.reason: This number runs fake SingPass verification calls claiming your national digital identity will be suspended.
indicators.advice: Hang up. SingPass never calls to suspend accounts or ask for one-time codes.

indicators.reason: This number is used for police and CPIB impersonation, claiming a warrant is out for the victim's arrest.
indicators.advice: Hang up. Singapore police never demand payment or bank details over the phone.

indicators.reason: Overseas number pattern linked to spoofed courier and customs calls targeting Singapore residents.
indicators.advice: Be careful. Real courier companies do not ask for card details or transfers by phone.

indicators.reason: Fake Merlion Bank login page harvesting credentials, one-time codes and card details.
indicators.advice: Do not log in there and do not enter codes or card details. Merlion Bank's app and official site never look like that.

indicators.reason: Phishing site cloned to look like the SingPass login page to steal credentials and one-time codes.
indicators.advice: Do not open it. SingPass is only ever at singpass.gov.sg.

indicators.reason: Fake bank refund page that harvests card numbers, expiry dates and CVVs.
indicators.advice: Do not enter card details there. Banks never process refunds by asking for your full card number.

indicators.reason: Fake parcel redelivery site charging a small 'customs fee' to capture card details.
indicators.advice: Do not pay or enter card details. Delete the message.

indicators.reason: Lookalike telco billing domain reported in phishing messages about 'failed payments'.
indicators.advice: Check your account only through the official telco app or website.

indicators.value: your parcel is held at customs. pay s$1.50 redelivery fee: http://parcel-redelivery-8492.xyz
indicators.reason: Classic parcel-customs-fee lure; the small fee is bait to steal card details.
indicators.advice: Delete it. Real Singapore Post never charges redelivery fees by link.

indicators.value: singpass: your account will be suspended. verify now at singpass-verify-account.top
indicators.reason: SingPass suspension scare with a cloned login link.
indicators.advice: Delete it. SingPass does not send suspension links by SMS.

indicators.value: spf notice: a warrant has been issued for your arrest. call +6580001003 immediately to avoid prosecution.
indicators.reason: Police-impersonation arrest warrant threat — the callback number is controlled by the scammer.
indicators.advice: Ignore it. Police do not issue warrants over SMS.

indicators.value: merlion bank: confirm a transaction of s$4,850 at once by replying with your otp or your card will be blocked
indicators.reason: Fake bank alert engineered to make victims reply with a one-time code.
indicators.advice: Never reply with an OTP. Merlion Bank will never ask for it — not by SMS, not by call.
